I can help, but I don’t have your location or live weather access in this chat.

Tell me your **city + country (or ZIP/postal code)** and, if you want, **C/F preference**, and I’ll summarize what today’s weather is like. If you paste a forecast (or a screenshot), I can interpret it too.
